name: ESP32-2432S028R (Cheap Yellow Display)
recoveryInstructions: Use a USB data cable and close any serial monitor before flashing.
This board has no PSRAM, so its page budget is 12 keys and its 2.19 MB deck partition holds fewer artwork images than the larger boards.
If automatic bootloader entry fails, hold BOOT while reconnecting the cable, then release BOOT and flash again.
If 921600 baud is unstable, the desktop automatically restarts the complete write once at 460800 baud.
Leave Full erase off to preserve saved decks; enable it only for slow, destructive troubleshooting.
The desktop resets the board automatically after a successful flash. If it does not reconnect, press RST or reconnect power.
